text:
jess: Quick design check — I'm leaning toward row-tiling (card-like separators between compare rows) instead of full-bleed rows to improve scannability. Putting a short prototype GIF in the thread: https://imgur.com/example (orsee). Can ppl weigh in on: visual density, badge alignment, and pin microcopy?

matt: row-tiling looks cleaner to me — helps separate variants when you have many metrics. but might add vertical space. worried about contrast between tile border and background at smaller widths.

ana: copying my earlier a11y note: tiles add extra focus stops if not implemented carefully. keyboard users should be able to jump row-by-row, not tile-element-by-element. recommend a single roving tabindex per row.

kevin: Agree with ana. Also +1 for tiling if we keep badges right-aligned in a fixed column. That preserves visual rhythm.

jess: good call on focus. Proposal microcopy for pin button (hover title + sr-only): Option A: "Pin version — keep this model in compare"; Option B: "Pin to compare"; Option C: "Keep pinned". Which reads best?

matt: Option B is concise. Option A is verbose but clearer. For SR-only maybe "Pin model to compare view" — explicit.

ana: For screen readers I'd avoid gerunds like "keeping". "Pin model to compare" or "Unpin model from compare" as the toggle label, and use aria-pressed on the button. Also ensure the control-level is announced: e.g. `aria-label=\"Pin model v2.1 to compare (pinned)\"` when toggled.

kevin: On badges: currently we have a performance badge (green/yellow/red). We should add a concise legend accessible from top of table — maybe a small "i" icon that opens a tooltip with both color meaning and metric thresholds (100ms < green < 300ms etc). Tooltips must be reachable by keyboard.

jess: mockup update: added a compact legend icon near header, and keyboard focus style uses 3px outline (brand blue). Thoughts on thickness?

matt: 3px is large, might look heavy in dense views. 2px dashed is an option. Ensure focus shadow doesn't obscure badge borders.

ana: Please run contrast check on outline color vs tile background. Also for tooltip content, include `role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"false\"` and ensure Esc closes it.

jess: quick poll: tiling vs full-bleed? react with :thumbsup: for tiling, :eyes: for full-bleed. I'll collect reactions in an hour and update PR with the chosen layout + aria changes.

design-bot: Accessibility checklist reminder: add keyboard-only walkthrough, screen-reader narration test, and color-blindness pass.

kevin: minor nit on microcopy: when toggled show ephemeral toast "Pinned to compare" (not modal). keep it 2s.

jess: noted. thanks all — will update the figma + PR. tagging @matt @ana for final a11y QA before merge.
